Per-point shape descriptors (orientation, curvature, torsion) of a curve

Source: R/axons.R
dot-point_shape.Rd

Estimates the unit tangent (orientation), local curvature and torsion at each point of a 3-D curve from its finite differences. Returns scalar per-point attributes suitable for fiber::streamline@point_data (each must be a numeric vector of length nrow(pts)), so the 3-D orientation is stored as its three components dir_x, dir_y, dir_z.

Usage

.point_shape(pts)

Arguments

pts

A numeric matrix with columns X, Y, Z.

Value

A list with numeric vectors curvature, torsion, dir_x, dir_y, dir_z, each of length nrow(pts).
